pages.text: $(italic)A whirlwind of steel and fury. Raw melee power that scales harder the closer you are to death.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -5%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Core Identity:$() +15% base melee damage on all weapons.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Brutal Strikes$(): +15% melee damage with every weapon, at all times.$(br2)$(bold)Blood Fury$(): +20% melee damage below 40% HP, the class's core risk and reward.$(br2)$(bold)Thick Skinned$(): +10% armor effectiveness, which rewards heavy armor.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Trance$(): +5% attack damage and +1 natural armor from your constant fury.

pages.title: Playstyle
pages.text: The $(thing)Berserker$() wants to be in melee range, taking hits. At low HP, Blood Fury and Brutal Strikes together give a huge burst, and Thick Skinned keeps you alive longer than your HP suggests.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Orc$(): +10% melee, which stacks to +25% base.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$(): +40% HP makes Blood Fury safer.$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$(): fire resistance and armor stacking.
